What it solves: UMBRELLA / tracking item (type: epic), NOT directly promotable - the
coordinator promotes CHILD slices, never this. Children carry
`epic: first-run-mutation-debt` and are listed in `decomposes_into`.
Approval context: This tracker asks one question and mints nothing on its own. BL-1441 discharged three deferred mutation gates on completed runs, as its spec allows, and those runs were the first time six production files had ever been mutation-tested.
